scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied in RESULT.md; verify.py performs finite independent numerical consistency checks that do not establish infinite-domain conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Only a time-stationary one-point variance and driving-force covariance are classified, not full stationary laws, passage times, or finite-time rates.
Requires independent strictly positive renewal intervals with finite first and second moments, independently restarted Brownian-force excursions, and positive harmonic relaxation.
At prescribed unequal first/second waiting-time moments, interval endpoints are strict nonattained infimum and supremum; their limiting laws are not admitted.
Broader renewal-filter or constrained-Laplace-transform results may imply the optimization component; independent priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: Sharp stationary-variance envelope for renewal-reset Brownian forcing in a harmonic trap
